question: The expression { sqrt[4]{34-24sqrt2} } × { sqrt{4+3sqrt2} } simplifies to:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Express 34 − 24√2 as a perfect square: 18 + 16 − 2(3√2)(4) = (3√2 − 4)².

The fourth root reduces to a square root: ⁴√(34 − 24√2) = √(3√2 − 4).

Multiply with the second term: √(3√2 − 4) × √(3√2 + 4).

⇒ √[(3√2)² − 4²] = √(18 − 16) = √2.

**∴ The correct answer is √2.**
